826 likes, 37 comments - mysmartprice on September 17, 2026: "Trust isn’t claimed. It’s earned. 🏆

Introducing Trust Icons of India — MySmartPrice Home Appliance Awards 2026, an ownership-based recognition shaped by the people who know their appliances best: the people who actually use them.

🏠 1,00,000+ appliance owners
⭐ 5,00,000+ individual ratings
📊 10 ownership attributes
📺 5 major appliance categories

From reliability and performance to after-sales service, energy efficiency and customer satisfaction — this is trust measured beyond the first impression.

To the MySmartPrice community: thank you for sharing your experiences and helping recognise the home appliance brands that have earned your trust.

Winners coming soon. 🏆

#TrustIconsOfIndia #MySmartPrice #MSPAwards2026 #HomeApplianceAwards #ConsumerTrust".
